thread:
tori (Accounts Payable): FYI received INV-533900 for $23,760 from Acme Cloud but PO field is empty and unit rates don't match our SOW. Auto-match failed. Need routing.
approvals-bot: Invoice 533900 queued. Match failed: missing PO; rate variance >10%.
acme-cloud-vendor: Hi Tori, apologies. Our billing system dropped the PO when exporting. Rates reflect a temporary overage billing, but we flagged it as disputed on our end. We can reissue corrected invoice referencing PO-2024-88 or confirm approval to adjust.
martin (Procurement): @tori can you attach the invoice excerpt? Also confirm which contract/SOW this ties to. If vendor can reissue with PO-2024-88 that's preferred.
tori (Accounts Payable): snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-533900
Amount: 23,760.00 USD
Line 1: 200 GPU hours @ 118.8/hr (no PO)
Note: disputed charge for idle instances
```
rachel (Tax): If they reissue, ensure tax line matches (VAT/GST). Otherwise, we need vendor attestation for correction.
acme-cloud-vendor: We can reissue within 3 business days. Their ops team also asked if Redwood will accept a short-term credit note instead of waiting for reissue.
martin (Procurement): Policy: credits/invoices must reference the PO or exception needed. @elaine can we approve an exception to accept vendor attestation + short-term credit so AP can net immediately?
elaine (Finance Dir): Send me the vendor attestation text and GL code. If it ties to existing PO-2024-88 and is clearly an overbilling correction, I'll sign exception. Don't forget to note variance reason for audit.
tori (Accounts Payable): GL: 6102-Cloud-SaaS. Vendor attestation: "Acme Cloud confirms INV-533900 is an overbilling for idle-instance usage and should be applied against PO-2024-88. A corrected invoice or credit note will follow." Attached.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-9822 created: credit application without PO; routed to Elaine (Finance Dir). Status: pending.
elaine (Finance Dir): Signed EXC-9822. AP team, please net a provisional credit of $23,760 to INV-533900 and mark as pending reissue. Procurement, please track reissued invoice with PO-2024-88.
tori (Accounts Payable): Done. Applied provisional credit, ledger updated, flagged pending. Will attach reissue when received.
acme-cloud-vendor: Thanks everyone, we'll reissue with PO-2024-88 and confirm tax lines. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :pray:
